description: The same capture starts queries with different original context ends (engine §4 and §10).
grammar:
%rule text ($x:candidate Y) %conditions ¬($x.matches(driver)), $x.onward.begins(driver)

%rule candidate (X [+T])
%rule driver $y:candidate %conditions $y.without-elision.matches(rival)

%rule rival (X [+T]) %conditions $.following-tokens.begins(tail)

%rule tail Y
